description:
About the Client
Our client is a well-established international company with a strong and stable presence in Vietnam. The organization operates within a structured environment, with clear governance standards and a focus on long-term business growth.
The role sits within a professional setup, working closely with senior management and regional stakeholders.
(Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.)
Key Responsibilities
* Lead and manage all legal and compliance matters for the Vietnam business
* Provide legal advisory to senior management on business operations and risk mitigation
* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts and agreements
* Ensure compliance with Vietnamese laws and internal corporate policies
* Support corporate governance and internal control frameworks
* Work closely with regional stakeholders to ensure alignment with group standards
* Liaise with external counsel and regulatory authorities when required
requirements_text:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (mandatory)
* Must hold a valid Vietnamese practicing lawyer certificate
* Minimum 8–12+ years of legal experience, including in-house exposure
* Strong expertise in corporate, commercial, and compliance
* Experience in multinational or structured corporate environments
* Fluent in English and Vietnamese
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to work with senior leadership

Luật / Pháp chế
